shapeVolume.outcome: A purposeful colony of thick, visibly hollow pink coral fingers, supported by violet accents and a compact cobalt reef base. Rounded lip thickness, gently organic shafts and coherent rock shoulders supply fuller cartoon volume in every facing.
checks: The tall-to-short fanned hierarchy remains recognizable at logical and phone sizes. Native form changes may improve the silhouette, proportions and construction.
Tube mouths read as deliberate open cavities rather than painted dark circles; clean rims and colored interior depth remain legible around the rotation.
Repair native cavity intrusions visible in the source N/E and small violet intrusions in S, without requiring original weak tube spacing or part counts.
Coral appears planted in finite reef material throughout gentle sway. Rock pieces form a coherent support rather than an arbitrary stack of intersecting slabs.

colorMaterialSeparation.outcome: Pink remains dominant, violet remains a supporting coral color, and cobalt blue anchors the reef. Warm rim tones and restrained native variation give material depth without bleaching the palette.
checks: Separate neighboring shafts, lips, inner cavities and rocks with readable colored midtones, local contact depth and intentional transitions.
No large near-black lower hub, flat neon expanse or blown cream highlight replaces the readable volume.

Small native green shoots, smaller violet tubes, spots or rock accents are optional useful design additions. They must support the main silhouette and survive intended size. Exact target decoration is not mandatory.

lightingHighlights.outcome: Broad soft highlights describe rounded forms and softened rock planes, with no preferred horizontal world light direction or directional ground shadow.
checks: Lips and turning planes carry soft warm light; highlights retain body color and do not become hard white piping, plastic glare or bloom.

Use one coherent native lighting/material treatment for every facing and phase, with horizontally symmetric illumination/reflection response. Original lamp powers, compositor contrast and roughness values are historical source details, not aesthetic locks.
Interior and base contact shading stays colored and localized, without dead black patches or opaque exported ground-shadow blobs.

detailReadabilityAndRole.outcome: The coral remains legible midground scenery beside the yellow submarine and eel, with controlled detail and quieter emphasis than gameplay actors or warning silhouettes.
checks: Read at the registered 192x384 logical canvas and the actual bounded 390px catalog interaction. Thick mouths, three palette groups and the fanned hierarchy survive reduction.
Avoid noisy pores, dense spots, high-frequency facets and gratuitous emissive/neon accents. Large structural form improvements carry the result.
A repeated 3x3 density check can reveal excessive visual busyness and accidental bright rows. This prop has no modular seam ports, so do not impose a seamless opaque square ground law.
The target's bright close-up is an aesthetic guide. Preserve scene hierarchy through native color/material/light choices; do not apply per-view exported recolors or alpha repair.
